tools.name: check_clp_label
tools.description: Checks the label elements of a hazardous chemical product (signal word, GHS pictograms, H/EUH and P statement codes, product identifier, "Contains" line) against the EU CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008: required elements, pictograms and signal word each hazard statement calls for, precedence rules,

tools.name: clp_statement_wording
tools.description: Returns the official wording of EU CLP hazard (H, EUH) and precautionary (P) statements in any of the 24 EU languages, as published in the consolidated CLP Regulation on EUR-Lex. "…" marks a part the supplier fills in (e.g. the substance or the disposal route).

tools.name: scan_amazon_listing
tools.description: Finds pesticide-type claims in an Amazon US product title or description ("kills germs", "disinfects", "repels insects", "prevents mold", "anti-allergen"…). Amazon treats such products as pesticides, which need an EPA registration number or a FIFRA exemption; the scan also lists any EPA registration

tools.name: cpsc_lab_lookup
tools.description: Looks up a testing laboratory on CPSC's list of accepted labs, by CPSC lab ID or by name (exact, or every word of it), and returns the rules (16 CFR parts and standards) it is accepted for. A children's product certificate needs a lab accepted for each rule it was tested to.

tools.name: cpsc_hts_flag
tools.description: Returns CPSC's eFiling flag for 10-digit HTS codes: CP2 (certificate data required) or CP1 (may be needed), with CPSC's product category. Not on the list does not mean no certificate is needed; the importer must eFile whenever a certificate is required.

tools.name: upcoming_rules
tools.description: Coming and recent changes to EU CLP, OSHA HCS, WHMIS, Quebec French-language, CPSC eFiling and Amazon dangerous-goods rules, each with its date, state (pending, upcoming, since) and the official source it was checked against.
